result.summary: The export button on the reports page returns a 500 error when no date range is set, instead of handling the empty input gracefully.
scope: Reproduce the 500 error with an empty date range on the reports export endpoint
Determine why the empty date range isn't handled before hitting the server
Add proper validation or a default/fallback for missing date range input
Verify the export works correctly once a date range is provided or defaulted
